+## #3909 - v0.27 guide batch 3
+
+**What was decided:** Cover the next eight unticked entries, in issue order.
+This is a partial umbrella contribution. It does not close #3909.
+
+| Merged PR | Guide section | Decision |
+|---|---|---|
+| [#3833](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3833) | 2D Contour | Explain the outside ramp, Helix substitution, tab and length limits, and compensation refusal. Do not promise ramped links between all rings. |
+| [#3861](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3861) | Command line: Control a running window | Give the call, bridge and discovery forms, window selection, undo ownership and refusal exits. Keep syntax separate from captured output. |
+| [#3900](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3900) | Tools: Create and edit a tool; First run | Replace the dock-pane description with the separate window and Document/Catalog sources. |
+| [#3903](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3903) | Tools: Create and edit a tool | Explain Tool and Details, Apply, the tool rail and independent drafts. |
+| [#3496](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3496) | Rotary Offset | Explain the Zigzag closing ring and the skipped duplicate seam edges. |
+| [#3516](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3516) | 2D Pocket | Explain protected picks, full-tool clearance, rest machining and the MCP setter. |
+| [#3579](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3579) | 2D Pocket | Quote the missed-relief note and explain that material remains at the boundary corner. |
+| [#3762](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3762) | Troubleshooting: GPU compute falls back to the CPU | Distinguish compute fallback from window rendering and driver recovery. |
+
+**Why:** The merged PRs and current implementation establish these behaviors.
+The existing pages omit them or still describe the former tool dock.
+The eight focused site tests pin the missing guide facts. The existing
+navigation test checks built links and anchors.
+
+**Considered and dropped:** A new tutorial, new screenshots and CAM changes
+are not needed for this prose batch. Existing operation pictures stay as
+illustrations, not evidence of the new behavior. Editing the shared MCP
+page was dropped because an open contribution changes it. The CLI page
+links to it instead. Other open 2D-guide changes affect Chamfer and Bore,
+not this batch's Contour and Pocket paragraphs. No stacking is needed.
+The current source has a Recipes tab as well as Tool and Details; this
+batch does not describe the editor as limited to two tabs.
+
+**Cost to change later:** Update the affected guide sections and their
+focused site assertions. No project format, generated program, machine
+file, snapshot or process policy changes.

+## Control a running window
+
+Start CamCraft first. The `--ui` lane sends the same
+[MCP tools](@/guide/automate/mcp.md) to that window. Each call runs on the
+window's own document and undo history: changes appear there, and **Ctrl+Z**
+undoes them. It never falls back to a separate headless document.
+
+Use these command forms (not captured output):
+
+```text
+camcraft-cli --ui windows
+camcraft-cli --ui [--window <pid|project>] call <tool> [<json-args>]
+camcraft-cli --ui [--window <pid|project>] mcp
+camcraft-cli --ui --help
+```
+
+`windows` lists process IDs, versions and open project paths from discovery
+files. A crashed window can leave a stale file. With several windows,
+choose one with `--window` and its process ID or open project path.
+`call` takes an MCP tool name and an optional JSON object. It prints the
+tool's answer. `mcp` bridges an agent's stdio MCP session to the window;
+it does not start another document. `script` and `process` do not take `--ui`.
+
+- No running window: exit 3, with nothing run.
+- Several windows without a selection, or invalid arguments: exit 2.
+- A refused tool call: exit 1.
+- A window busy with another command: exit 4. Wait for that command to end.
+- A successful call: exit 0.
+
+Discovery uses the current user's local link folder. Do not share its
+files: they contain the connection token. `CAMCRAFT_UI_LINK_DIR` overrides
+that folder. A window started with `CAMCRAFT_UI_LINK=off` has no link.
+

+ring. This removes the cusps between row ends on flats and other walls
+perpendicular to the rows. A ring that wraps the full turn skips the seam's

+this does not change the Adaptive seam refusals below.

+## GPU compute falls back to the CPU
+
+The log can report `uncaptured GPU error` or `GPU compute device lost`.
+The shared compute device then stays disabled for the rest of the process.
+CamCraft keeps the first failure reason, logs it once, and uses the CPU
+path for later stock-cut calculations. It does not repeatedly recreate
+the failed compute device.
+
+To start with compute disabled, set `CAMCRAFT_GPU_COMPUTE=off` before
+starting CamCraft. This does not select the adapter that draws the window.
+A compute fallback is not recovery from every graphics driver failure:
+if the window cannot render, use the window troubleshooting steps above.
+The CPU fallback does not bypass verification or establish machine safety.
+

+"""Provenance: merged CamCraft PRs listed in #3909, guide batch 3."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import unittest
+
+
+GUIDE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "content" / "guide"
+
+
+def section(page, heading):
+    text = (GUIDE / page).read_text()
+    marker = f"## {heading}\n"
+    assert marker in text, f"Missing guide section: {heading}"
+    body = text.split(marker, 1)[1].split("\n## ", 1)[0]
+    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", body)
+
+
+class Release027Batch3(unittest.TestCase):
+    def facts(self, text, *facts):
+        for fact in facts:
+            with self.subTest(fact=fact):
+                self.assertIn(fact, text)
+
+    def test_3833_outside_contour_entry_names_limits(self):
+        text = section("operations/operations-2d.md", "2D Contour")
+        self.facts(text, "outside", "lead-in and ring", "each level",
+                   "Helix", "tabs", "too short", "compensation")
+
+    def test_3861_cli_ui_targets_existing_history(self):
+        text = section("automate/cli.md", "Control a running window")
+        self.facts(text, "--ui windows", "--window", "call", "mcp",
+                   "Ctrl+Z", "exit 3", "exit 2", "exit 1", "exit 4",
+                   "never falls back", "CAMCRAFT_UI_LINK=off")
+
+    def test_3900_library_is_a_window_not_a_dock_tab(self):
+        text = section("set-up/tools.md", "Create and edit a tool")
+        self.facts(text, "**Tool library** window", "**Document**", "**Catalog**",
+                   "dock tab is gone", "Properties")
+        first_run = (GUIDE / "getting-started/first-run.md").read_text()
+        self.assertNotIn("**Tool library** pane", first_run)
+
+    def test_3903_editor_keeps_separate_drafts(self):
+        text = section("set-up/tools.md", "Create and edit a tool")
+        self.facts(text, "**Tool** tab", "**Details** tab", "**All tools**",
+                   "own draft", "one undo step", "part number")
+
+    def test_3496_rotary_zigzag_closes_walls_without_double_seam(self):
+        text = section("multi-axis/operations-multiaxis.md", "Rotary Offset")
+        self.facts(text, "**Zigzag**", "closing ring", "seam", "cusps",
+                   "twice")
+
+    def test_3516_pocket_protection_covers_full_assembly(self):
+        text = section("operations/operations-2d.md", "2D Pocket")
+        self.facts(text, "**Do not touch**", "**Pick protected**", "**Clearance**",
+                   "flutes, shank and holder", "rest machining", "refused")
+
+    def test_3579_missed_relief_names_boundary_corner(self):
+        text = section("operations/operations-2d.md", "2D Pocket")
+        self.facts(text, "corner relief at (x, y) is not cut: no pass vertex reaches the relief spur",
+                   "boundary corner", "once", "material remains")
+
+    def test_3762_compute_fallback_is_not_window_recovery(self):
+        text = section("reference/troubleshooting.md", "GPU compute falls back to the CPU")
+        self.facts(text, "uncaptured GPU error", "GPU compute device lost",
+                   "first", "rest of the process", "CAMCRAFT_GPU_COMPUTE=off",
+                   "window", "graphics driver")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
